integrity: Analytic proof with exact symbolic algebra cross-check. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The classification is proved only for real hyperbolic three-space of sectional curvature -1, a>1, and nonnegative oscillation frequency; a<=1 and higher dimensions are not considered. Priority outside inspected sources remains uncertain.
title: Sharp oscillation threshold for exponentially damped geodesic covariance on hyperbolic three-space
